title: Diagnostic Loss: Asymmetric Supervision for Radiology Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated radiology report generation requires models to do more than produce fluent clinical narratives: they must explicitly state supported diagnoses while avoiding unsupported ones. However, existing medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) are typically trained with token-level maximum likelihood objectives, which prioritize text agreement over diagnostically critical terms. As a result, models can miss key diagnoses and introduce wrong ones. We identify this as an objective misalignment between conventional language modeling and the asymmetric diagnostic requirements of radiology reporting. To encode these requirements, we introduce Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic objective that operates directly on decoder token probabilities. translated_title: 诊断损失：面向放射学报告生成的非对称监督
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30980v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：自动化放射学报告生成要求模型不仅仅是产出流畅的临床叙述：模型必须明确陈述有依据的诊断，同时避免给出无依据的诊断。然而，现有的医学视觉-语言模型（MedVLMs）通常采用词元级的最大似然目标进行训练，这类目标优先考虑文本一致性，而非诊断上的关键术语。其结果是，模型可能遗漏关键诊断并引入错误的诊断。我们将此问题识别为传统语言建模目标与放射学报告非对称诊断需求之间的目标错位。为了编码这些需求，我们提出了诊断损失（DLoss），这是一种可微分、与架构无关的目标函数，直接作用于解码器的词元概率。DLoss 分别在与参考报告中支持诊断相关联的词表、以及与不被支持的替代诊断相关联的词表上聚合概率质量。通过对聚合方式使用非对称……
tldr: 提出诊断损失（DLoss），一种直接作用于解码器词元概率的可微分、架构无关的非对称监督目标，解决医学视觉-语言模型在放射学报告生成中遗漏关键诊断、引入错误诊断的目标错位问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic asymmetric supervision objective that operates directly on decoder token probabilities, addressing the objective misalignment that causes medical vision-language models to miss key diagnoses and introduce unsupported ones in radiology report generation.
